paite: Unaute aw, hiaite na theih louh uh ka deih kei, huchi a i pipute tengteng meipi nuai a a-om vek ua, avek ua tuipi leng akan ua,
heading: Israelte Tanchin A Pan Sinsakna
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

paite: avek ua meipi leh tuipi a Mosi a baptis lut a a-om vek ua,
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

paite: avek ua khalam an kibang anek chiat ua,
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

paite: avek ua khalam dawn ding kibang adawn chiatdan uh. Amaute zui, khalam Suangpi a pan adawn chiat ngal ua; huai Suangpi Khrist ahi.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

paite: Himahleh alak ua mi tamzaw tung ah Pathian alunghita kei a; gamdai ah apuklum uhi.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

paite: Huan huai thilte ei ding a etton ding ahi, thil gilou alunggulh bang ua i lunggulh samlouhna ding in.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat milim bemi ahih bang un milim bemi hi kei un, "Mipite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, lam ding in adingh nawn chiat uh," chih gelh bang in.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

paite: Alak ua khenkhat in nungak angai ua, ni khat in singnih-le-sangthum in apuklup loh bang un, i kingai kei ding uh.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat in Toupa aze-et ua, gul a hihman a a-om bang un, Toupa zaw i ze-et kei ding uh.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

paite: Alak ua khenkhat aphun ua, hihmangthangpa hihmanthat a a-om bang un, phun sam kei ni.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

paite: Huan huaite vaukholhna ding in atung uah ahong tung hi; eite, hun tawp hong tunnate, hon thuhilhna ding a leng gelh ahi uhi.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

paite: Huaiziak in dingh a kingaihtuah pilvang hen, huchi lou in zaw apuk kha ding hi.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

paite: Mihing thuak theih val khemna himhim na tuang uah atung ngei kei hi. Pathian zaw amuanhuai hi, ama'n na thuak theih val uh khemna na tuah uh aphal kei ding; na thuaktheihna ding un khemna peuh ah taikhiakna lampi abawl zaw ding hi.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

paite: Huaiziak in ka deihtakte aw, milim biak taisan un.
heading: Milim Biak Taisan Un
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

paite: Mipilte kiang a gen bang in ka thugente ngaihtuah un.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

paite: Vualzawlna nou a ka hon vualzawl uh, Khrist sisan kikoppihna ahi kei a hia? Tanghou ka balkhap uh Khrist pumpi kikoppihna ahi kei a hia?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

paite: Eite mi tampi tanghou beu khat, pum khat i hi uh; i vek un tanghou beu khat ah i tang chiat uhi.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

paite: Salam a Israelte en dih ua; kithoihna sa nete'n maitam thilte akikoppih kei ua hia?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

paite: Bang ka genna ahia le? Milim lak a kithoihna leh milim leng banghiamtak ahi chih ka genna hia?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

paite: Zentelte kithoihna, Pathian lak ah hilou in dawite lak ah akithoih uh ahi chih ka gen zaw ahi; noute zaw dawite toh na kithuah uh hon deih lou ka hi.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

paite: Toupa nou leh dawi nou na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh; Toupa dohkan leh dawi dohkan ah na nekhawm thei sam kei ding uh.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

paite: Ahihkeileh Toupa hazatna tohthoh i tum uh ahi maw? Amah sang in i hatzaw ua hia?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

paite: "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoih kei, "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih in mi abawlhoih kei hi.
heading: Khristian Noplenna Zatdik
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

paite: Kuapeuh in amah hoihna ding zong lou in midang hoihna ding zong zaw hen.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

paite: Sa dawr a azuak peuhmah uh na sia-le-pha theihna ziak un bangmah dong lou in ne un.
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

paite: "Lei leh asung a tengteng Toupa a ahi ngal a."
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

paite: Gingloumi lak a kuahiam in nou hon sap a, hoh na ut ngal un, sia-le-pha theihna ziak in bangmah dong lou in, ahon lui peuh uh ne un.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

paite: Himahleh kuahiam in, "Hiai zaw kithoihna ahi chi a ahon hilh leh sia-le-pha theihna ziak leh nou a hon hilhpa ziak in ne kei un,"
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

paite: Nangmah sia-le-pha theihna ka chi kei a, ama sia-le-pha theihna pen ahi ka chih zawk. Bang achia midang sia-le-pha theihna in ka noplenna thunun ahia?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

paite: Kipaktak a ka tanleh atung a kipahthu ka genna tung ah bang ding a gensiat a om ka hia?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

paite: Huchi in na nek uhiam na dawn uhiam, na hih peuhmah uh, Pathian thupina ding ngen in hih un.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

paite: Judate a ding hiam, Grikte a ding hiam, Pathian saptuamte a ding hiam in apukna ding uh bangmah hih kei un.
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

paite: Ke'n keimah phattuamna zong lou a, hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua mi tampi phattuamna zong a, mi tengteng bangkim a ka kipahsak bang in.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
